answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 8691 Country: Pakistan Title: A person living in dubai sends money to pakistan for the qurbani because, of much difference in the cost of animal. is it ok? Question: A person living in dubai sends money to pakistan for the qurbani because, of much difference in the cost of animal. is it ok? Answer ID: 8691 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1445/1213=L/1429) It is allowed, but the Qurbani should be done in Pakistan on a day which is Qurbani day in Dubai as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
